15.t: Working with data: crude oil fractions
q: Which fraction makes up the most of the crude oil?
30 − 12 = 18 percentage points more demand than supply.
Explain why refineries have too much fuel oil and bitumen.
Crude oil contains a lot of long-chain hydrocarbons but people need fewer of them than they need petrol.
Explain how the refinery can solve the mismatch, and why it makes money.
Cracking breaks long, low-demand molecules into shorter ones for petrol, plus alkenes for plastics. Petrol sells for more than fuel oil.
